children: CBOT December wheat (WZ26) may test resistance at $7.30-1/2 per bushel, a break above which could lead to a gain into the $7.38-1/4 to $7.47-1/2 range.
The fall from $7.62-1/2 could be well broken down into five small waves, a structure signalling the completion of a bigger wave c.
The contract is expected to bounce toward the peak of the wave iv at $7.43-1/2. Support is at $7.13-3/4, a break below which could confirm the extension of the wave c toward $6.98-1/2.

On the daily chart, a rising channel suggests limited downside, as the channel line establishes support around $7.05, forming a support zone with the higher support of $7.13-3/4 to stop a further fall.
A rise above $7.30 could be the first sign of the uptrend continuation.
